modelDetails.description: Z-Image-Turbo is a distilled version of the Z-Image family that generates images in 8 function evaluations, with sub-second latency on H800 GPUs and a fit within 16G VRAM consumer devices.

intendedUse.primaryIntendedUseCases: Photorealistic image generation; bilingual (English and Chinese) text rendering in images; generation that follows detailed instructions

factors.hardware: Sub-second inference on enterprise-grade H800 GPUs; fits within 16G VRAM consumer devices
factors.software: Hugging Face diffusers, installed from source for Z-Image support

evaluation.performance: Highly competitive against other leading models and state of the art among open-source models

trainingData.algorithm: Decoupled-DMD few-step distillation (CFG augmentation and distribution matching) fused with reinforcement learning (DMDR)
trainingData.procedure: Pre-training, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, distilled to 8 steps
